changelog:
Initial release of the using-creed skill, establishing the workflow and ground rules for Creed-enabled workspaces:

- Defines Creed’s role as the source of software engineering judgment, with clear moats over test design, SOLID, and PR proof.
- Summarizes when and how to invoke Creed skills, including a full task flow and skill map.
- Details “Red Flags” to help identify when Creed must be applied instead of generic agent or workflow approaches.
- Provides a concise checklist to guide every productive turn.
- Clarifies Creed’s priority over workflow skills when approaching SE judgment topics (tests, design, PRs).
